reason: The core strategy is an intraday gapping breakout day trade held all day with entries and stops based on post-open range narrowing that cannot be approximated on daily bars.

setup.rule: gapping stocks looking for narrowing range after the open
setup.quote: they're basically trading gapping stocks and looking for a narrowing range after the open after they've they're gapping up looking, you know, they would get in on a break out of the range and use a stop on the other side of the tightening range and then they would just hold all day.

entry.quote: get in on a break out of the range

stop.rule: stop on the other side of the tightening range
stop.quote: use a stop on the other side of the tightening range

exits.quote: they would just hold all day

sizing.rule: risk a certain dollar amount per trade
sizing.quote: I was going to risk a certain dollar amount per trade
